Frequently asked questions about copier rental in Makati

Do you support copier rental in Ayala, Salcedo, and Legazpi?

Yes. We can review copier needs for those Makati office districts and recommend a setup based on building access, user count, and expected workload.

Should Makati teams ask for mono or color copier rental first?

If most output is contracts, invoices, and HR files, mono may be enough. If your team prints decks or client materials, share color requirements in the quote request.

Can a copier rental support shared scan workflows?

Yes. Tell us how many users need access, how the copier should connect to your network, and where scanned files usually flow so setup can be planned correctly.

Which nearby copier pages should Makati teams compare when coverage expands?
